meta.name: HAXcms in the browser
meta.about: What haxcms-browser does and the services it works with, from its README and docs/providers.md. Services marked in progress are built and need their OAuth app registered on a deployment before they show.

browser.desc: haxcms-nodejs running in a browser tab at browser.hax.cloud: make sites with no install, keep them in a folder, the browser or cloud storage, sign in with an account you have, and publish for free. Which services a deployment offers depends on the OAuth apps whoever runs it registers (docs/providers.md).

br_worker.desc: The whole haxcms-nodejs app, bundled with esbuild, running in a Web Worker with an in-memory file system. Every result must match haxcms-nodejs on Node: a parity scenario runs the same requests on both.

br_relay.desc: The HAXcms pages in the frame ask for URLs as usual; the service worker hands each request to the page that owns the Worker and returns its answer. Nothing HAXcms asks for reaches the web server.

br_broker.desc: Small stateless Vercel functions deployed with the page: they finish sign-ins with each app's client secret and pass Surge uploads on. They keep nothing and only answer their own page.

st_folder.desc: A folder the person picks on their computer (File System Access, Chromium browsers). Each site is a normal HAXsite folder in it.

st_browser.desc: The browser's own private file system: the default, and what Firefox and Safari use. Browsers can clear it when space runs low, so the bar suggests a folder or the cloud.

st_gdrive.desc: A "HAXcms sites" folder in the person's Drive, with the drive.file scope: HAXcms only reaches files it made.
st_gdrive.note: Built; works once the deployment registers this service's app (haxtheweb/issues#3341).

st_onedrive.desc: OneDrive's Apps/<app> folder, the only folder the app can reach (Files.ReadWrite.AppFolder).
st_onedrive.note: Built; works once the deployment registers this service's app (haxtheweb/issues#3341).

st_dropbox.desc: Dropbox's app folder, with scoped access.
st_dropbox.note: Built; works once the deployment registers this service's app (haxtheweb/issues#3341).

st_box.desc: A "HAXcms sites" folder in Box. Box only answers browser calls from origins listed on the app.
st_box.note: Built; works once the deployment registers this service's app (haxtheweb/issues#3341).

st_webdav.desc: Any WebDAV server the person points at, with an app password that is never stored. The server has to allow the page's origin (for Nextcloud, the WebAppPassword app).
st_webdav.note: Built; works once the deployment registers this service's app (haxtheweb/issues#3341).

si_google.desc: Sign in with Google; name, email and picture become the author of new sites.
si_google.note: Built; works once the deployment registers this service's app (haxtheweb/issues#3341).

si_microsoft.desc: Sign in with a work, school or personal Microsoft account.
si_microsoft.note: Built; works once the deployment registers this service's app (haxtheweb/issues#3341).

si_github.desc: Sign in with GitHub through the HAX GitHub App.
si_github.note: Built; works once the deployment registers this service's app (haxtheweb/issues#3341).

si_gitlab.note: Built; works once the deployment registers this service's app (haxtheweb/issues#3341).

si_apple.desc: Sign in with Apple; Apple posts back to the broker, which passes on only the name and email.
si_apple.note: Built; works once the deployment registers this service's app (haxtheweb/issues#3341).

pb_surge.desc: Free *.surge.sh addresses with a Surge token or email and password, through the broker (up to about 4 MB per site; the dialog says so).

pb_ghpages.desc: A public repository named after the site, with .nojekyll, and Pages turned on.
pb_ghpages.note: Built; works once the deployment registers this service's app (haxtheweb/issues#3341).

pb_glpages.desc: A public project with the site in public/ and a .gitlab-ci.yml pages job.
pb_glpages.note: Built; works once the deployment registers this service's app (haxtheweb/issues#3341).

pb_cbpages.desc: A public repository with the site on its pages branch and the git-pages webhook.
pb_cbpages.note: Built; works once the deployment registers this service's app (haxtheweb/issues#3341).

pb_netlify.desc: A Netlify site, deployed by file digest so republishing sends only what changed.
pb_netlify.note: Built; works once the deployment registers this service's app (haxtheweb/issues#3341).

pb_vercel.desc: A production deployment of a Vercel project, through the HAX Vercel integration.
pb_vercel.note: Built; works once the deployment registers this service's app (haxtheweb/issues#3341).

pb_download.desc: Always there: HAXcms's own zip of the site, to publish anywhere with the HAX CLI.

tours.label: From zero to a published site
tours.message: No install, no server: sign in, keep the site somewhere safe, publish it free.

scenes.caption: Open browser.hax.cloud: HAXcms Node.js runs in the tab.
Sign in with an account you have; you become the author of the sites you make.
Keep the sites in a folder, the browser or cloud storage you already have.
Publish free, straight from the browser.
